plugins.name: Pomodoro
plugins.description: A focus timer on the left screen and the underglow: focus, short rests and a long rest every four rounds, with keys to pause and restart.

plugins.name: Mic mute
plugins.description: Shows whether your microphone is muted, red on the keyboard and MUTED on the left screen, and mutes or unmutes it from a key.

plugins.name: Broadcast Status
plugins.description: Shows whether OBS is recording or streaming, REC or LIVE and the scene on the left screen and red on the keyboard. It only listens to OBS on this PC.

plugins.name: SignalRGB
plugins.description: Lets SignalRGB light your Foxglove keyboard along with the rest of your setup.

plugins.name: OpenRGB
plugins.description: Receives OpenRGB's E1.31 output and shows it on your keyboard.

plugins.name: Corsair iCUE
plugins.description: Your keyboard's underglow follows a Corsair device's colours in iCUE (mirroring only). Needs iCUE and Corsair's iCUE SDK, which you download from Corsair.

plugins.name: Logitech LIGHTSYNC
plugins.description: Mirrors G HUB's lighting onto your keyboard.
